theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) : A ⊆ B ↔ A ∩ B = A := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [set.inter_eq_left]
    apply eq_set_of_subset
    exact h
  · intro h
    intro x hx
    have := set.mem_inter.1 hx
    exact (h.mp this).2
    apply subset_iff.1
    exact this
